details.label: Internship Program
details.title: Impevos Summer Internship Program
intro: At Impevos, we are launching our internship program for students with mandatory summer internships.
During this process, students will gain experience by actively participating in real project workflows, not just observing.
Our goal is to provide young talents with a genuine work environment in software, design, project management, and teamwork.
eligible: Students enrolled in relevant university departments
Those interested in software, design, mobile apps, web development, or digital projects
Individuals who can take responsibility and adapt to teamwork
Students who are eager to learn and communicate effectively
